display_long_description:
The Watertour app is your gateway to the awe-inspiring world of the Dlouhé Stráně Pumped Hydro Storage Plant in the Czech Republic. Combining cutting-edge virtual reality and interactive storytelling, Watertour offers an unforgettable exploration of this engineering marvel hidden in the heart of the Jeseníky Mountains.

Embark on a journey to discover the secrets of this pumped-storage facility. Delve into the science of renewable energy with interactive 3D models of the upper reservoir, turbines, and underground tunnels. Learn how the plant stores and generates electricity, supporting the stability of the grid.

Experience the breathtaking views from the plant's iconic upper reservoir and feel the rush of water flowing through its massive turbines. Challenge yourself with quizzes tailored to your curiosity and learn why hydro power is a cornerstone of sustainable energy for the future.Watertour transforms learning about renewable energy into an exciting adventure!
